note: Lean has the Laplace-type identity (eq:oscfft) only for compactly supported tests and keeps it as a field `axis` of `Lights`; the manuscript's height-independence computation by differentiation is upstream.

snippet.text:
def during (F : Waves S) (W : Surface S) := ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Heights n), y∈east n→ ∀ f : Joint n, ∀ h : HasCompactSupport ⇑f,
    Distn.fourier (W.W n v) f=F.psi v y (Probe.hat (lifts (dawn y) f h))

proof_context.conclusion: `during` says the Fourier transform of `W.W n v` against a compactly supported test `f` equals `psi v y` of the exponentially lifted, transformed test, for every ordered height `y`.
